the Hofstede's paradigm is no longer relevant in the twenty first cross cultural management environment and Asian management researchers need more self confidence to contribute to the global knowledge pool.

the Hofstede (1980, 2007) cultural dimensions are still useful in the twenty first Century but that they are not enough to capture new cross cultural management environments and that Asian management researchers need more self confidence to contribute to theory building with a global relevance.
